subject: Commitment lifeline: MAP & contingency proposal
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Ho <alice.ho@luminexa.com>, Todd Smythe <todd.smythe@luminexa.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commitment lifeline: MAP & contingency proposal

Alice / Todd —

Thanks again for the call this morning. I wanted to capture the immediate runway risk and propose a short, concrete MAP update to keep the go-live window intact while we resolve the outstanding procurement gating items. High level: there are two things moving in parallel that threaten the target go-live on 2027-07-12 — (A) procurement billing-cycle approval (legal/ops paper) and (B) acceptance window compression from Luminexa's integration team.

Quick risk summary (extracted from today's notes):
- Procurement: final PO expected but billing cycle change could push approval by 2–3 weeks.
- Integration: acceptance tests currently scoped for a 7-day window; integration team capacity could reduce that to 2 days unless we provide a canary plan.
- Contingency: without mitigation we estimate a 10–18 business day slip to the close date.

Proposed immediate MAP changes (draft):
1) Add a 2-week contingency buffer to the official MAP with granular checkpoints every 3 business days.
2) Execute a canary cutover for the most critical tenant set to validate end-to-end flows in a reduced window.
3) Conditional credit: Redwood offers a one-time credit (up to $20k) if procurement lags beyond agreed checkpoints to offset the integration rework runway.
4) Deliverables & owners: see attached MAP_v3.xlsx (owner column populated) + risk_register_snapshot.pdf.

Ask: please review the attached and confirm whether Luminexa can commit to the 3-day checkpoints (first checkpoint: 2027-06-17). If procurement needs more formal artifact, Todd — can you confirm the earliest billing cycle cutoff for PO acceptance?

I'll follow up with a short version for our internal ops and CS teams.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_v3.xlsx (draft), risk_register_snapshot.pdf

From: Alice Ho <alice.ho@luminexa.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Todd Smythe <todd.smythe@luminexa.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commitment lifeline: MAP & contingency proposal

Marissa —

Thanks for pulling this together and for the clear options. We appreciate the flexibility. Quick notes from the procurement side: legal needs the final terms by Monday 6/14 to hit the current July cycle; if we miss that we slip to the August billing run. I'll speak to Legal tomorrow and confirm.

On integration: the team can run a 3-day acceptance window only if Redwood provides the canary plan and test checklist by EOD 6/15. Otherwise, we're limited to the 2-day window the integration manager mentioned.

We can agree in principle to the checkpoints. About the conditional credit — that's something I need to sign off with our CFO. Todd, can you advise?

I'll loop back Monday with a short procurement timeline PDF (attached).

—Alice
Alice Ho | Director, Integrations
Luminexa
Attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Ho <alice.ho@luminexa.com>, Todd Smythe <todd.smythe@luminexa.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commitment lifeline: MAP & contingency proposal

Alice / Todd —

Appreciate the quick reply and the procurement timeline. Per the integration ask, attached is a canary checklist + a trimmed MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) with specific owner commitments and 3-day checkpoint dates. Summary of changes in MAP_v3:
- Canary scope: 5 core flows (auth, embeddings, chat, metrics export, shutdown) — target canary run: 6/21–6/23.
- Checkpoints: 6/17 (procurement status), 6/21 (canary readiness), 6/24 (acceptance gating decision).
- Buffering proposal: temporarily add +10 business days to the milestone float and activate conditional credit clause if procurement misses 6/17 checkpoint.

If you're comfortable, we'd like a quick alignment call 6/15 at 10:00 AM PT to confirm the canary checklist and ownership. If procurement can't hit 6/17, we'll prepare the credit request paperwork and escalate internally.

Action items (short):
- Alice: confirm 6/15 call + procurement decision cadence.
- Todd: confirm whether Luminexa can sign off on a conditional credit conversation with CFO if procurement slips.
- Camila: I'll need you to own the canary plan ops side (runbooks + rollback).

Thanks — I attached MAP_v3.xlsx and the risk_register_snapshot.pdf again.

Best,
Marissa
Attachment: MAP_v3.xlsx (updated), risk_register_snapshot.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Ho <alice.ho@luminexa.com>, Todd Smythe <todd.smythe@luminexa.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commitment lifeline: MAP & contingency proposal

Folks —

Reading the MAP_v3 and risk snapshot. From a deal governance + finance perspective I want to flag two items and escalate for approval:

1) Conditional credit up to $20k — requires Sales Ops + Finance approval.
   - Rationale: preserves customer velocity and avoids a multi-week slip that increases overall cost to both sides.
   - Ask: Marissa, please open a formal credit request (amount, trigger checkpoint, repayment/offset terms) — I'll route to Finance.

2) MAP buffer activation — if procurement misses 6/17 checkpoint we should mark the deal as "at-risk" in HubSpot and trigger an exec review (Camila + Sales Leadership).

Risk log note to include in the packet: (copied from risk_register_snapshot.pdf)
- Risk #12: PO cycle mismatch — probability: high, impact: high, mitigation: conditional credit; deadline: 2027-06-17.
- Risk #15: Acceptance window compression — probability: medium, impact: medium, mitigation: canary run 6/21–6/23.

I'll support the credit routing. Marissa — once you open the request I'll add the financial justification and push to Finance slack channel. Camila — can you confirm runbook ownership and expected time to produce the canary artifacts by EOD 6/15?

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations (on behalf of Deal Desk)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Ho <alice.ho@luminexa.com>, Todd Smythe <todd.smythe@luminexa.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commitment lifeline: MAP & contingency proposal

Thanks — quick escalation/update for internal track and exec briefing.

Status as of 6/18:
- Procurement: Alice confirmed legal will try to make the 6/14 cutoff but CFO sign-off still pending. HubSpot now set to 'At Risk' per Rishi's note. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/13942
- Canary: Camila confirmed runbooks in progress; draft will be shared tonight (ETA 23:00 PT).
- Credit request: I filed the formal credit request in Sales Ops (request id: CR-2027-451). DocuSign packet is ready — pushing to Sales Leadership and Finance for approval: https://docusign.example.com/txn/8a7b9c

Next steps & owners:
- Camila: finalize canary runbook + rollback steps by 6/18 EOD.
- Rishi: route CR-2027-451 to Finance + Sales Leadership for sign-off; recommend we hold the canary window 6/21 regardless so integration has visibility.
- Alice/Todd: confirm procurement outcome by checkpoint 6/17; if missed, we execute buffer + credit clause and coordinate schedule adjustments for go-live.

I'll prepare an exec one-pager for Monday summarizing the risk log and proposed credit terms. If we get sign-off this week we can keep the original 7/12 go-live date; if not, expect conversion to the contingency runway and update of the MAP.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: (canary_runbook_draft.pdf referenced)
